terra.problem: Saying the men did not go because they had a score of their own to settle adds a reason the text does not give.
The text says they brought the plunder to the camp, not that nothing was left behind on the road.
The officers getting quiet is an invented reaction. Marking it as a guess does not establish that it happened.
The explanation calls Balak king of Moab and connects him to Balaam's story without a reference for those facts from outside the passage.
The description of Og as a king Israel met on the road is a fact from outside the passage and needs a reference.
Keeping the whole camp happy is not a reason the text gives for the division.
The commanders report that none of the soldiers is missing. The text does not say that every man made it back.
The report that no soldier was missing does not establish that everyone was physically present when they counted.
Moses later climbing Mount Nebo and the Tent of Meeting's location in the camp are facts from outside this passage and need references.
